question: Mrs. Hilt's favorite first grade classes are baking muffins. Mrs. Brier's class bakes 18 muffins, Mrs. MacAdams's class bakes 20 muffins, and Mrs. Flannery's class bakes 17 muffins. How many muffins does first grade bake in all?
Mary's mom is getting ready for Mary's birthday party. She blew up 6 balloons this morning and 5 balloons this afternoon. How many balloons did she blow up in all?
Charles found 6 pennies on his way to school. He also had 3 nickels already at home. How much money does he now have in all?
Mrs. Hilt had 38 marbles. She lost 15 of them. How many marbles does she have left?
Mrs. Hilt spent 1 hour and 30 minutes shoveling snow on Saturday morning and 45 minutes shoveling snow on Saturday afternoon. How much total time did she spend shoveling snow?
I have 3 hundreds, 8 tens, and 3 ones. What number am I?
The puppet show begins at 2:00 p.m. It lasts 1 hour and 30 minutes. What time does it end?
Dan has $3.00. He bought a candy bar for $1.00. How much money is left?
I have 9 pennies, 4 nickels, and 3 dimes. How much money do I have?
Hailey's bus is third in line. Danny's bus is 3 buses behind hers. What place in line is Danny's bus?
Rob has seven quarters, three dimes, five nickels, and twelve pennies. How much money does Rob have?
Rachel is third in line. Julie is 2 spots in front of her. What place in line is Julie?
The train left for the station at 9:45 and arrived at 10:00. How long did it take?
The rest of the kids around town got 13 more eggs around the club house, 9 eggs around the park and 8 eggs in the town hall garden. If we add all the eggs that they got, how many eggs would that be?
After the aviary was the zoo's swamp area. Penny counted a total of 55 tree frogs, 10 poison frogs and 13 wood frogs. How many frogs was Penny able to count?
Helen's mother brought 101 hotdogs. After a few hours, Dylan's mother arrived with 379 hotdogs. How many hotdogs do they have altogether?
Their next opponent was the Green Team. If their final score is 68 points and they led by 29 points, what is Green Team's final score?

For the first main dish, they were asked to cook steak. If the third and second team cooked 240 plates of steak. And the first team cooked 75 plates less than what the second and third team made, how many steaks did they cook altogether?

After the mountain country, she went to the famous beach on the continent. There, she collected 291 seashells of different colors. If she has 76 red shells and 49 green shells, how many shells are not red or green?
Lastly, Andrew tried to compute his expenses for the game night. If he spent $9.00 for each game they played and they played a total of 5 games, how much money did he spend that night?

Daniel and his brother Ben went to their grandfather's farm for a few weeks of vacation. During their stay at the farm, they were asked to take care of the animals. One day, his grandfather asked if he could count the total number of sheep that they have. If there are 3 herds of sheep and each herd has 20 sheep, how many sheep do they have in total?
Next on his list is the city's Orphanage for Young Girls. He bought roses, lilies, sunflowers and daisies. If he bought 40 pieces of each flower, how many flowers did the orphanage receive?
Mayor Harvey wanted to add color to the party. He bought 7 flowers each representing the 7 colors of the rainbow. If he had 70 bouquets of flowers for each color, how many bouquets are there in all?
Bryan had 8 precious stones in his collection which he sold to his friend from the jewelry store. If the stones were sold at $1785.00 each, how much money did Bryan get in total?
Having this kind of collection made Jack a fast reader. If he can read 9 books in a day, how many books can he read in a year (a year = 365 days)?
Marian also prepared 59 croissants which she plans to give to her 8 neighbors. If each neighbor received and equal number of croissants, how many will be left with Marian?

Susie and her family woke up early on the first weekend of spring. They had a long list of activities for spring cleaning. Susie's mom prepared 74 carrot sticks for breakfast. If the carrots were served equally to 12 people, how many carrot sticks were left uneaten?
Matt had 4 small cans of gold paint. If the 34 stars that they made were to be distributed equally to the cans of paint, how many stars will be left unpainted?
At the zoo, I see 35 elephants and 48 tigers. How many legs do I see?
Chris gave his 35 friends 12 pieces of candy each. How many pieces of candy did Chris give his friends?
I have 648 pencils. If I put 4 pencils in each pencil box, how many pencil boxes will I fill?
Mrs. Hilt bought a notebook for $1.30. She paid with nickels. How many nickels did she use to buy the notebook?

For breakfast, Colton bought a muffin for $1.80 and a cup of coffee for $1.40. For lunch, Colton had soup, a salad, and lemonade. The soup cost $2.75, the salad cost $6.70, and the lemonade cost $1.70. How much more money did Colton spend on lunch than on breakfast?
Anita needs 26 cartons of berries to make a berry cobbler. She already has 10 cartons of strawberries and 9 cartons of blueberries. How many more cartons of berries should Anita buy?
Reshay and Natalie order eggs for $5.15, pancakes for $3.20, and 2 mugs of cocoa for $0.60 each. The tax is $0.75. How much change should they get from $15.00?
A group of 4 children and 3 adults are going to the zoo. Child tickets cost $3, and adult tickets cost $6. How much will the zoo tickets cost in all?
Ruth has 8 white buttons. She has 6 fewer brown buttons than white buttons. Ruth has 3 more gray buttons than brown buttons. How many buttons does Ruth have in all?

Many families serve each person in the family one 6-ounce glass of orange juice each morning. If they buy orange juice by the gallon, how many whole servings of juice will they get out of one gallon (one gallon = 4 quarts, 1 quart = 32 ounces) of juice?
Mrs. Hilt has 6 pizzas. Each pizza has 6 slices. She sold one-fourth of the pizza slices. How many slices were left?
Mrs. Hilt bought 15 boxes of citrus fruits from a fundraiser. She paid $12 for each box. If 6% sales tax was added to the total cost, how much was her total bill?
Mrs. Hilt will buy a new pair of shoes in 11 days. How many minutes must she wait before she can buy her new pair of shoes?
Harry walked along the beach and collected 34 sea stars, 21 seashells and 29 snails. He lost some of the items and had 59 items left at the end of his walk. How many sea creatures did he lose in all?
Teacher buys 4 black pens and 4 blue pens for students as awards. How many pens does the teacher buy altogether?
There are 56 students in the class. The teacher wants to split them into two groups. The first group has 24 students. How many more students will there be in the second group?
An online toy store stocked some toys. It sold 38 toys at the first week and 26 toys at the second week. If it had 19 toys left, how many toys were in stock at the beginning?
Mother bought some potatoes. She used 15 of the potatoes to make salads and 24 of the potatoes for mashed potatoes. If there were 13 potatoes left, how many potatoes did mother buy at first?

Mr. Peter harvested some pears. He picked 43 kg of the pears into a bag and 35 kg of the pears into another bag. If there were still 15 kg of pears left unpacked, how many kilograms of pears did Mr. Peter harvest?
Jack is reading a 285-page book. If he reads 23 pages per day, how many days will he take to finish reading the book?
The capacity of a tank is 32 gallons. If a company bought 728 gallons of oil, how much oil is in the tank that is not full?
The teacher gave 42 pencils to 12 students equally. How many pencils did each student get?
There are 22 dogs in the farm. They live in 5 dog-houses equally. How many dogs are left?

A transport company bought 95 tons of oil. A large barrel can hold 6 tons of oil and a small barrel can hold 5 tons of oil. In order to use the least number of barrels and have every barrel fully occupied, how many large barrels should be used?

A worker needs to cut a 27-yard long rope into some long pieces at 4 yard each and some short pieces at 1 yard each. In order to make the least number of pieces, how many long pieces should be cut for?
172 students are forming teams for a mountaineering competition. Each team should have 18 students. How many teams can they form?
There are 250 vitamins in a bottle. Gil takes 12 vitamins per day. How many vitamins short of his usual 12 vitamins is Gil on the day the bottle runs out?
The weight of 4 cakes is 800 g. The total weight of 3 cakes and 5 pieces of bread is 1 kg 100 g. How much heavier is a cake than a piece of bread?

Tony packs a bag of fruits every 10 min, Sam packs a bag of fruits every 8 min and Sarah packs a bag of fruits every 12 min. If they start packing three bags of fruits at the same time at 12:55, at what time will they start packing at the same time again?

Three workers are working to cut the trees. Worker X can cut a tree every 16 min, Worker Y every 32 min and Worker C every 24 min. If they start cutting three trees at the same time at 7:48, at what time will they start cutting trees at the same time again?

Three carpenters are installing some doors for a building. Carpenter A installs a door every 40 min, Carpenter B installs a door every 1 h 20 min and Carpenter C installs a door every 1 h 40 min. If they start installing three doors at the same time at 9:15, at what time will they install doors at the same again?
Gabriel scores 56 in Math and 84 in Science. Find the ratio of his scores in Math to Science.
In a basket, there are 24 good oranges and rest are bad oranges. The ratio of good oranges to the bad oranges is 3:1, find the number of bad oranges.
A radio station is having a promotion in which every 12th caller receives a free concert ticket and every 15th caller receives a limo ride. Which caller will be the first one to win both?

I want to plant 45 sunflower plants, 81 corn plants and 63 tomato plants in my garden. If I put the same number of plants in each row and each row has only one type of plant, what is the greatest number of plants I can put in one row?
Ricky has a magic money box. Every day the box doubles the number of coins placed inside of it. Ricky put in 3 pennies on Monday. He looked inside his box on Friday. How many pennies did Ricky see?
I put another number into my machine. The machine added 15 and then subtracted 6. The number 35 came out of the machine. What number did I put in?

There are four pieces of paper in a bag. Each paper has a number on it. The numbers are 19, 23, 34, and 38. Harry took out one piece of paper. The sum of the remaining numbers was 76. What number did Harry remove from the bag?
A comic book costs 37 cents. The store owner reversed the digits by mistake. He wrote that number on the comic book. How much did the store owner overcharge his customer?

Mr. Bradley gave his class a math problem to solve. He said, "Begin with the number 28. Add 12 to it. Then add 7 more." Ned followed the instructions perfectly but Billy subtracted 7. What is the difference between the boys' answers?

Greg's mom made some cookies for the family. The cookies were so huge that she decided to cut them in half. Greg ate 4 halves and his brother, Brad, had 6 halves. There were 18 halves left. How many whole cookies did Greg's mom make?
There were 18 girls and 15 boys on the track team. 7 more girls joined the team. 4 boys quit the team. How many children were on the track team then?
Anna has a total of 28 nickels and dimes in her piggy bank. She has 8 fewer nickels than dimes. How many dimes does Anna have?

Zachary collects cans for the recycling club. On the first day, he found 4 cans. On the second day, he found 9 cans. He found 14 cans on the third day. If this pattern continues, how many cans do you  think Zachary will find on the seventh day?
Suzanne read the first 15 pages of her book on Monday. She read 16 more pages than that on Tuesday. Then there were 18 pages left. How many pages are in Suzanne's book altogether?

Tina had a large collection of beanie babies. She gave 8 beanie babies to her cousin. She gave half that amount to her sister. She gave 36 beanie babies to needy children. She kept 12 for herself. How many beanie babies were in Tina's collection at first?
David spent 74 cents. He bought a ruler for 29 cents and a folder for 25 cents. He also bought 2 pencils. How much does one pencil cost?
Kyle bought 3 presents. The first present cost $18. The second present cost $7 more than the first. The third present cost $11 less than the first. How much did Kyle pay for all 3 presents?
A worm has fallen into a hole that is 26 inches deep. It climbs up 8 inches and slides back 3 inches every day. How many days will it take the worm to reach the top?

Evan delivers packages in a building. He started on the first floor and went up 7 floors. He went down 3 floors and then up 16 floors. Then he was only 2 floors away from the top of the building. How many floors are in the building altogether?
Omar loves to play checkers. He played 37 games yesterday. He played 49 games today. Omar lost 18 games. How many games did he win?
J.T. has some superhero trading cards. He lost 14 of them. He gave 19 of them to his best friend. Now he has 45 cards left. How many cards did J.T. have at first?

A committee organizing a marathon has 16 jugs of water and 12 jugs of sports drink. The committee would like to set up a number of refreshment stations along the marathon course, with the same combination of jugs of water and jugs of sports drink at each station, with no beverages left over. What is the greatest number of refreshment stations that can be set up?
Laurie has 12 more marbles than Kurt. Kurt has 45 marbles less than Dennis. Dennis has 70 marbles. How many marbles does Laurie have?

Jake set up a candy stand in his front yard. He has 80 pieces of candy to sell. He sold 15 pieces of candy on Monday. He sold much more than that on Tuesday. By Wednesday, Jakes only had 7 pieces left. How many pieces of candy did Jake sell on Tuesday?

Corey earns extra money finding lost golf balls. His goal is to find 48 golfballs every weekend. He found 16 golf balls on Saturday. He found 18 more golf balls on Sunday. How many more golf balls does Corey need to find to reach his goal?
Ben had 18 marbles and John had 17 marbles. Ben gave half of his marbles to John. How many more marbles did John have than Ben then?

William sells hot dogs at the ball park. He sold 19 hot dogs during the first three innings. He sold 27 hot dogs during the next three innings. William had 45 hot dogs left to sell. How many hot dogs did William have at first?

Ramon works at the supermarket. He put 26 boxes of Choco Delights on the shelf. There were already 15 boxes there. Later that day, Ramon counted 22 boxes on the shelf. How many boxes of Choco Delights were missing?
Amy has 67 balloons. 29 of them are red and 17 are green. The rest of the balloons are blue. How many blue balloons does Amy have?

Kayla got a new video game. She scored 2 points on the first level, 3 points on the second level, 5 points on the third level, 8 points on the fourth level, and 12 points on the fifth level. If this pattern continues, how many points will Kayla score on the sixth level?

Derek is picking flowers in the garden. He picked 18 flowers from the first bush, 22 flowers from the second bush, 26 flowers from the third bush, 30 flowers from the fourth bush, and 34 flowers from the fifth bush. If this pattern continues, how many flowers will Derek pick from the sixth bush?

Jared owns a hardware store and is looking over his past orders. Jared's hardware store ordered 5 power drills in January, 6 power drills in February, 8 power drills in March, and 11 power drills in April. If this pattern continues, how many power drills will the store order in May?

A baker is putting cupcakes on trays to cool. She put 3 cupcakes on the first tray, 6 cupcakes on the second tray, 12 cupcakes on the third tray, and 24 cupcakes on the fourth tray. If this pattern continues, how many cupcakes will the baker put on the fifth tray?

On a modern art painting, there are 3 green dots in the first row, 6 green dots in the second row, 9 green dots in the third row, and 12 green dots in the fourth row. If this pattern continues, how many green dots will there be in the fifth row?
3 tons of mulch cost $15,000.00. What is the price per pound?
Kira has $1.20 in quarters and dimes. She has minimized coins altogether. How many coins does she have?
You have $12 in nickels and quarters. If you have the same number of each kind of coin, how many nickels do you have?
Thomas made 8700 mL of tomato soup. He packed 1.6 L of the soup in his kids' lunches. He then froze half of the remaining soup. How many milliliters of soup did Thomas freeze?
Payton leaves to go on an 85 minute bike ride at 3:27 p.m. Payton's family eats dinner at 5:45 p.m. How much time will Payton have between finishing her bike ride and eating dinner?

Gina mixed paint to make her favorite shade of purple. She filled up one third of the container with red paint. Then she filled the remaining space with 4 L of blue paint. How many milliliters of paint did Gina mix?
A restaurant charges 4% service charge. If your order amounted to 450, how much did you pay?
Luz and Raya talked for one hour and 21 minutes on the phone. They ended talking at 1:06 a.m. What time did they start talking with each other?
Time in the Philippines is one hour ahead of the time in Japan. Luz who is in Manila called up her friend who is in Japan at 12:55 am on 25 December 2014. What day and time was it in Japan?
Two numbers are in the ratio 3:8. Their sum is 44. What is the difference between the two numbers?

Lavender is making punch for the school dance. She mixes 3 parts lemonade with 5 parts cranberry juice. She wants to fill a 72 cup bowl. How many more cups of cranberry juice will she need than lemonade?
Ted and David shared 24 stickers in the ratio 3:5. David used 8 of his stickers. What was the ratio of Ted's stickers to David's sticker's then?
Cory made 4500 g of candy. He saved 1 kg to eat later. He divided the rest of the candy over 7 bowls to serve at his party. How many grams of candy did Cory serve in each bowl?
Jemma filled one-fourth of a barrel with compost on Saturday. Then she filled the remaining space with 4200 g of compost on Sunday. How many kilograms of compost are in the barrel?

The teacher is handing out note cards to her students. She gave 3 note cards to the first student, 12 note cards to the second student, 48 note cards to the third student, and 192 note cards to the fourth student. If this pattern continues, how many note cards will the teacher give to the fifth student?

Whitney has collected 4 T-shirts and 20 buttons from her favorite band. She wants to combine them into identical sets to sell, with no pieces left over. What is the greatest number of sets Whitney can make?
Laverne has 20 baseballs and 15 basketballs. If she wants to divide them into identical groups without any balls left over, what is the greatest number of groups Laverne can make?

At a concert, the band has 20 men's T-shirts and 8 women's T-shirts. The band wants to set up tables to sell the shirts, with an equal number of men's and women's shirts available at each table and no shirts left over. What is the greatest number of tables the band can sell shirts from?
This afternoon, Alec noticed that the number of the page assigned for homework is divisible by both 4 and 13. What is the smallest possible page number that could have been assigned?
Bianca wanted to drink exactly 5 bottles of water each day, so she bought 47 bottles when they were on sale. How many more bottles will she need to buy on the last day?
A movie store had 9 movies they were putting on 2 shelves. If the owner wanted to make sure each shelf had the same number of movies, how many more movies would he need?
At the carnival, 6 friends bought 27 tickets. If they wanted to split all the tickets so each friend got the same amount, how many more tickets would they need to buy?
An art museum had 15 pictures to split equally into 2 different exhibits. How many more pictures would they need to make sure each exhibit had the same amount?
Luke had 9 pieces of candy. If he wants to split the candy into 2 bags with the same amount of candy in each bag, how many more pieces would he need to make sure each bag had the same amount?
A school had 14 students sign up for the trivia teams. If they wanted to have 4 team, with the same number of students on each team, how many more students would need to sign up?
Candies come in packages of 4. Shirley ate 10 candies. How many candies does she have left?
Audrey has 26 peaches. Paul has 48 peaches. What's the difference of the number of Audrey's peaches and Paul's peaches?
Sharon has seven plums. Allan has 10 plums. What's the difference of the number of Sharon's plums and Allan's plums?
Mrs. Sheridan has 11 cats. Mrs. Garrett has 24 cats. What's the difference of the number of Mrs. Sheridan's cats and Mrs. Garrett's cats?
Haley collected 9 cans for recycling. If she put 7 cans in one bag, what's the difference between the number of recycling cans that Haley collected and put in the bag?
Tom used 2 batteries on his flashlights, 15 in his toys and 2 in his controllers. What's the difference between the number of Tom's batteries on flashlights and in toys?
Pete, Bryan and Philip are cousins. Pete's age is one-third of Bryan and Philip is five years elder than Bryan. If the sum of the age of the cousins is 40, find the ages of each.
Kate is 12 years old. His age is 4 times the age of Robbie. Find the age of Robbie.
The present ages of Lewis and Brown are in the ratio 1:2. Three years from now, the ages will be in the ratio 3:5. Find the present ages of Lewis and Brown.
Thrice the sum of a number and 2 equals 24 added with the same number. Write algebraic equation and find the number.
Consider three consecutive positive integers. If the third number is subtracted from the sum of first two numbers, the difference is 10. Find the numbers.
A number added with thrice a number is 20. Convert this statement into algebraic equations and find the number.
The difference of two numbers is 100. If one of the numbers is 91, find the other number.
One-third of a number minus seven gives eight. Find the number.
I think of a number. If I subtract 6 from the number and divide it by 13, I will get the result as 2. Find the number in my mind.
Wilson has a number in mind. If he takes away one-third of the number from it the result is sixteen-third. Find the number.
The sum of two numbers is 132, whose ratio is 5:6. Find the numbers.
A number equals 5 times the difference between the number and 4. Find the number.
The sides of scalene triangle are in the ratio 2:4:3 and its perimeter are 27 inches. Find the sides of the triangle.
The perimeter of two squares ABCD and PQRS are 3:2 respectively. The sums of the perimeters of the squares are 30. Find the perimeter of ABCD and PQRS.
If one pack of gum costs $2, how many packs of gum can you buy with $16?
There were eight red roses and two white roses in the vase. Melanie cut some more roses from her flower garden. There are now fourteen red roses in the vase. How many red roses did she cut ?
Fred bought five new baseball trading cards to add to his collection. The next day his dog ate half of his collection. There are now only twenty-six cards left. How many cards did Fred start with ?
Oceanside Bike Rental Shop charges a 17 dollar fixed fee plus 7 dollars an hour for renting a bike. Mary paid 80 dollars to rent a bike. How many hours did she pay to have the bike checked out ?
Sachin says that he has 6 books more than the 6 times of the books Priyanka has. Sachin has 42 books. How many books does Priyanka have?
In an isosceles triangle, the base angles are equal. The vertex angle is twice either base angle. What are the angles of the triangle?
The present age of Jacob's father is three times that of Jacob. After 5 years, sum of their ages would be 70 years. Find their present ages.
Two years ago, a father was five times as old as his son. Two years later, his age will be 8 more than the age of the son. Find the present ages of father and son.
The sum of the digits of a two number is 15. The number is decreased by 27 the digits are reversed. Find the number.

A man walks certain distance with certain speed. If he walks 1/2 km/hr faster, he takes 1 hr less. But if he walks 1 km/hr slower, he takes 3 more hours. Find the distance covered by the man and his original rate of walking.
A car goes uphill at the rate of 30 km an hour and downhill at the rate of 50 km an hour after 15 hours it has covered 650 km. How long did it go downhill and uphill respectively?

A train covered a certain distance at a uniform speed. If the train would have been 6 km/hr faster it would have 8 hours less than the scheduled time, and if the train were slower by 6 km/hr,it would have taken 12 hours more than the scheduled time. Find the length of the journey.
The coach of a cricket team buys 7 bats and 6 balls for $3800. Later, he buys 3 bats and 5 balls for $1750. Find the cost of each bat and each ball.
The difference between two numbers is 26 and greater number is three times the smaller. Find the numbers.
The sum of the digits of a two-digit number is 9. Also, nine times this number is twice the number obtained by reversing the order of the digits. Find the number.
The larger of two supplementary angles exceeds the smaller by 18 degrees. Find them.

The area of a rectangle gets reduced by 9 square units, if its length is reduced by 5 units and breadth is increased by 3 units. If we increase the length by 3 units and the breadth by 2 units, the area increases by 67 square units. Find the dimensions of the rectangle.
Two number are in the ratio 3:4. sum of two numbers is equal to 56. Find the numbers.
In a 2-digit number, the tens digit is 4 times the units digit. When the digits are reversed, the new number formed is 54 less than the original number. Find the original number.
A sofa and a love seat together costs $444. The sofa costs double the love seat. How much do they each cost?
An electrician cuts a 30 ft piece of wire into two pieces. One piece is 2 ft longer than the other. How long are the pieces?
A number plus itself, plus twice itself, plus 4 times itself, is equal to 104. What is the number?
Two angles of a triangle are the same size. The third angle is 3 times as large as the first. How large are the angles?
A mountain cabin on 1 acre of land costs $30,000. If the land cost 4 times as much as the cabin, what was the cost of each?
Of 240 stamps that Harry and his sister collected, Harry collected 3 times as many as his sisters. How many did each collect?
A 6 ft board is cut into two pieces, one twice as long as the other. How long are the pieces?
The total cost for tuition plus room and board at State University is $2,584. Tuition costs $704 more than room and board. What is the tuition fee?
The cost of a private pilot course is $1,275. The flight portion costs $625 more than the ground school portion. What is the cost of each?
Mrs. Hilt owns a house on a lot shaped like a rectangle. The width is twice its length. The perimeter of the lot is 60 feet. What is the length and the width of the lot?
A square kitchen has an area of 100 square feet. What is the kitchen's perimeter?
Math Magazine charges $8 per square inch for advertising. Jason decides to order a half page ad. Each page of the magazine measures 9 inches by 12 inches. How much will Jason have to pay?
The distance around a rectangular garden is 36 feet. One side measures 10 feet. What is the area of the garden?
Mrs. Garvey's bathroom measures 6 feet by 10 feet. She wants to cover the floor with square tiles. The sides of the tiles are 6 inches. How many tiles will Mrs. Garvey need?
A rectangle has an area of 360 square centimeters. It is 20 centimeters long. What is its perimeter?
A square has sides that measure 15 cm. A rectangle has a length of 18 cm. The perimeter of the square is equal to the perimeter of the rectangle. What is the area of the rectangle?

Grandma has an old family recipe for blueberry pancakes. She can make 8 pancakes that are each 10 inches in diameter. Grandma decided that the pancakes were way too large for her grandchildren and decided to make pancakes that were only 2 inches in diameter. How many small pancakes will Grandma's recipe make?
Ben draws a circle inside a square piece of paper whose area is 400 square inches. He makes sure than the circle touches each side of the square. What is the area of the circle?

A length of wire is cut into several smaller pieces. Each of the smaller pieces are bent into squares. Each square has a side that measures 2 centimeters. The total area of the smaller squares is 92 square centimeters. What was the original length of wire?

Theo tied his dog, Flash, to a pole in the middle of the yard using a 10 ft. leash. Flash dug holes in the yard everywhere he could reach. Theo had to reseed the part of the lawn that Flash destroyed. Grass seed costs $1.40 per package and covers 50 square feet. What did it cost Theo to reseed the lawn?
A triangle has a perimeter of 90 cm. The lengths of the three sides are in the ratio 5:12:13. What is the length of the shortest side?
The ratio of the area of a rectangle to the area of a triangle is 2:5. The rectangle has a length of 6 cm and a width of 4 cm. What is the area of the triangle?
The saucer for Mika's teacup has a radius of 3 centimeters. What is the saucer's area?
In Mrs. Hutchinson's kindergarten class, children make handprints in a round clay mold for their parents. The mold has a diameter of 4 inches. What is the mold's radius?
Each side of a square kitchen tile is 7 inches long. What is the tile's area?
The perimeter of a postcard is 20 inches. The postcard is 6 inches wide. How tall is it?
Vanessa received six hundred twenty-two dollars for her birthday. Later she found some toys that cost nine dollars each. How much money would she have left if she bought as many as she could?
John's dad bought four hundred fourteen meters of string. If he wanted to cut the string into pieces with each piece being seven meters long, how many full sized pieces could he make?
A librarian had to pack five hundred ninety books into boxes. If each box can hold three books, how many boxes did she need?
There are five hundred fifty-four students going to a trivia competition. If each school van can hold nine students, how many vans will they need?
Each house a carpenter builds needs six sinks. If he bought two hundred sixty-six sinks, how many houses would that cover?
There are two hundred eighty-seven people attending a luncheon. If a table can hold nine people, how many tables do they need?
A school ordered 195 new pencils for the state tests. If they gave each student 3 pencils, how many students are in the school?
Amy had 180 video games. If she placed the games into 9 different stacks, how many games would be in each stack?
A farmer had 225 seeds to plant. He planted the same number of seeds each day and it took him 5 days to plant them all. How many seeds did he plant per day?
For Halloween Adam received 201 pieces of candy. If he put them into piles with 43 in each pile, approximately how many piles could he make?
An electronics store had 163 video games. If they put them on shelves with 84 on each shelf, about how many shelves would they need?
A lawn had an area of 20 square feet. If it was 5 feet width, how long was it?
Billy was painting a wall in his room. The total area was 8 square feet. If the wall was 2 feet wide, how tall is it?
A window had a length of 6 feet and a width of 10 feet. What is the area of the window?
A piece of plywood had a total area of 24 square feet, with a width of 6 feet. What is the length of the wood?
A book had a length of 5 inches and a total area of 50 square inches. How wide is the book?
A classroom had 35 glue sticks. If the ratio of glue sticks to glue bottles was 5:2, how many glue bottles did the classroom have?

During a class election the ratio of students who voted for candidate A compared to candidate B was 2:1. If candidate A received 14 votes, what is the combined amount of votes candidate A and candidate B received?
